finding: One melee hit resolves on one animation frame, once per swing; in the same frame, with damage above zero: hit sound, blood billboard, knockback set, combat voice roll, then health removed. No hit-stop or screen shake exists in the game code read.

Knockback is 40*d^2/(W+10d) in classic units (d damage, W victim weight), clamped to 15..40, decaying 5 per classic update, hurt state above 5. The donor's two-step expression reduces to this one line (checked numerically).

Defect: WeaponManager.cs 578-580 leaves the class-or-weight OR ungrouped, so monsters with weight above zero bypass the live-knock guard; the enemy-on-enemy path at EnemyAttack.cs 336 groups it correctly. Fix: group as in 336.
The player side gets only a full-screen red flash (0.4 alpha, 0.7 per second fade) on damage; no hit sound, blood or knockback on the player in the code read. Change: add player-side hit feedback.
Death is deferred one update by a flag, then the corpse marker, body-fall clip at the loot position and the death event fire; no freeze or fade found in that path.

Blood is a one-shot billboard at 10 fps; falling damage reuses it at the centre of mass (5 HP per metre above a threshold). Hit sound picks one of five weapon clips or two unarmed clips at random; the 1.1 argument is volume scale, not pitch.

No hit-stop, shake, flash, sound or knockback code in the C++ source. Hit reactions are authored as Havok graph event names (HitFrame, CamHit, blockHitStop, staggerStart, FlinchStart) and magnitude variables (staggerMagnitude, recoilMagnitude); names only, the engine is not in the box. Verdict PARTIAL.

One timing rule in the code: a combat-style scalar fallbackMult rescales a min to max window, value = min + mult*(max-min), for fallback distance (floored at twice the bound radius) and wait. Best transferable idea for row 4 only: one scalar per enemy style scales back-off windows.
